reset: i_rstn and i_ddr_rstn are asynchronous-assert, synchronous-release resets derived from one common raw reset. Asserting or restarting only one domain is forbidden.
ownership: Exactly one request from source acceptance through source response consumption; no slot reuse.
request_cdc: Source holds write/address/data from i_req_valid&&o_req_ready until response consumption. req_toggle_src crosses req_toggle_meta_ddr and req_toggle_sync_ddr; the DDR domain copies the stable bus when it differs from req_toggle_seen_ddr.
response_cdc: DDR holds data/error from rsp_toggle_ddr publication until rsp_ack_sync_ddr matches. rsp_toggle_ddr crosses rsp_toggle_meta_src and rsp_toggle_sync_src; source copies once and holds o_rsp_* until i_rsp_ready.
paxi: AW is held until accepted. W is first offered on the immediately following DDR cycle and held until accepted; W is never allowed to precede AW. A write response means only that both were accepted. AR can be accepted on the same DDR edge as the sole R beat. WSTRB is 16'h0000 and WLAST remains asserted with WVALID.
address: Native PAXI [0x1a00000,0x2000000), aligned to a native stride of 8.
fault: Sticky until the common reset clears both domains; no retry.
timeout: C_TIMEOUT defaults to 27'h7ffffff and is overrideable only for verification.
